title: Satri-cel: first CAR-T approved for a solid tumour

research.what: CARsgen identified Claudin18.2 as a CAR-T target in solid tumours and took the CT041 product into early clinical trials. Origin: CARsgen's CT041 Claudin18.2-targeted CAR-T programme and early clinical trials from about 2018, followed by the CT041-ST-01 randomised phase 2 trial published in The Lancet

change.what: China's NMPA approved satri-cel on 22 June 2026 for Claudin18.2-positive advanced gastric or gastro-oesophageal junction cancer, the first CAR-T approval for a solid tumour anywhere.

note: It extends CAR-T cell therapy beyond blood cancers to a solid tumour, which had been the main barrier for the field.

security.note: No notable cyber implications beyond routine clinical and manufacturing data security.

title: V-2 (A-4): first object to reach space

research.what: German army engineers at Peenemünde began developing the large liquid-propellant A-4 rocket, building on the earlier Aggregat test vehicles. Origin: Peenemünde Army Research Center A-series (A1–A4) programme under Wernher von Braun, development from 1936

change.what: Test launch MW 18014 on 20 June 1944 took an A-4/V-2 to about 176 km, above the later 100 km Kármán line, making it the first human-made object to reach space; the V-2 then entered service as the first long-range ballistic missile.

note: The V-2 was the technical and personnel basis for the US and Soviet rocket programmes that led to satellites and crewed flight.

refs.label: Space.com: V2 rocket origin, history and legacy

security.note: It started the ballistic-missile era and the military dependence on space-launch and guidance technology.
